SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No. ________
Section 1, Special Branch Station,
REPORT    Date August 25, 1938.

Subject E. W. WESTWOOD.

Made by D. S. Pitts    Forwarded by [签名]

In addition to the details given in a report dated
August 24, 1938 in regard to Ernest William WESTWOOD, British,
I have to state that this individual appeared before the local
British Police Court on August 21, 1934 when he answered the
following charges:-
(1) Driving motor car No. 8979 on August 7, 1934 on Bubbling
Well Road, Shanghai, while under the influence of drink
to such an extent as to be incapable of having proper
control of the said motor car, contrary to section 15
of the Road Traffic Act, 1930.
(2) Driving motor car No. 8979 on August 7, 1934 on Bubbling
Well Road, Shanghai, in a manner which was dangerous to
the public, contrary to Section 11 of the Road Traffic
Act, 1930.
(3) Driving motor car No. 8979 on August 7, 1934 on Bubbling
Well Road, Shanghai, without a licence to drive a motor
car, contrary to Byelaw 36, Traffic Regulation 34.
He was found guilty on each charge and fined £50 or one
month's imprisonment on each of the first two counts and
$25 in respect of the third.
After this incident, which eventually culminated in his
losing his post with Messrs. Culty Dairy, he appeared to go
from bad to worse in his drinking habits, finally reducing
himself from a position of comparative wealth to one of
penury.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号 ________
特别课第一股，
报告    日期：1938年8月25日。

事由：E. W. WESTWOOD（韦斯特伍德）。

制作人：D. S. Pitts（皮茨）    转呈人：[签名]

除1938年8月24日关于英籍人士欧内斯特·威廉·韦斯特伍德（Ernest William WESTWOOD）的报告中所列细节外，本人须陈述，此人曾于1934年8月21日出庭受审于本地英国警察法庭，当时他对以下指控作出答辩：-
(1) 1934年8月7日，在上海静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）驾驶车牌号为8979的机动车时，因饮酒至无法适当控制该机动车的程度，违反1930年《道路交通法》第15条。
(2) 1934年8月7日，在上海静安寺路驾驶车牌号为8939的机动车时，以危害公众的方式驾驶，违反1930年《道路交通法》第11条。
(3) 1934年8月7日，在上海静安寺路驾驶车牌号为8979的机动车时，未持有机动车驾驶执照，违反交通规章第34条附则第36条。
他被裁定每项罪名成立，前两项罪名各被判处罚金50英镑或监禁一个月，第三项罪名的罚金为25美元。
在此事件之后——该事件最终导致他失去了在卡尔蒂乳品公司（Messrs. Culty Dairy）的职位——他的酗酒习惯似乎每况愈下，最终使他从相对富裕的境况跌落至贫困潦倒。

Section 1...3p...Br........Station,
REPORT
Date August 24, 1938.

Subject R. W. WESTWOOD, British.

Made by D.S. Pitts.    Forwarded by [签名]

Ernest William WESTWOOD, British, was born at Wuhu on
July 7, 1898. His father, an Australian, was for many years
connected with the China Inland Mission as an active missionary
in the interior of this country.

The son was educated at the C.I.M. Chefoo Schools and later
in Brisbane. After completing his studies he returned to the
Far East and for many years, also was working in various
capacities for the China Inland Mission.

In October 1923 he was arrested by the local French Police
and charged with being drunk and disorderly. He was fined
$20 for this offence.

In 1931 he broke away from his missionary friends and being
an expert auditor, accountant and secretary, secured a
responsible post with Messrs. Culty Dairy, 1567 Avenue Joffre.
He retained this position until March 1935 when he was dismiss-
ed on account of his intemperate habits. He was always
considered an excellent man at his job until his craving for
alcohol got the better of him, when he invariably "went on a
binge" for weeks at a time. Perfectly reliable and capable
when sober, he is said to have been a fiend with an uncontrollable
temper when under the influence of strong drink.

In April 1935 WESTWOOD, now unemployed, registered himself
with the Salvation Army and although he has for certain periods
resided in the Salvation Army Hostel in Yang Terrace, he has
never caused this organization a great deal of trouble and
has received but meagre financial support from it.

Since losing his post with Messrs. Cultry Dairy he has been
employed in Shanghai for short periods with:-

第一股...3页...Br ____ 分局，
报告
日期：1938年8月24日。

事由：R. W. WESTWOOD（韦斯特伍德），英籍。

制作人：D.S. Pitts（皮茨）。    转呈人：[签名]

欧内斯特·威廉·韦斯特伍德（Ernest William WESTWOOD），英籍，1898年7月7日出生于芜湖。其父为澳大利亚人，多年来作为中国内地会（China Inland Mission）的活跃传教士，在中国内地从事传教工作。

其子曾就读于中国内地会烟台学校（C.I.M. Chefoo Schools），后在布里斯班求学。完成学业后，他返回远东，并多年以各种身份为中国内地会工作。

1923年10月，他被当地法国巡捕逮捕，并被控醉酒及行为不检。为此罪行他被罚款20美元。

1931年，他与传教士朋友们决裂。作为一名精通审计、会计和秘书工作的专家，他在霞飞路1567号的卡尔蒂乳品公司（Messrs. Culty Dairy）谋得一份要职。他一直保持该职位直至1935年3月，终因酗酒无度而被解雇。在酒瘾失控之前，他一直被视为工作中的佼佼者；一旦酒瘾发作，他 invariably 会连续数周“狂饮滥醉”。清醒时他完全可靠且能干，但据称在烈酒影响下，他会变成一个脾气无法控制的恶魔。

1935年4月，失业的韦斯特伍德在救世军登记。虽然他在某些时期居住在杨泰路（Yang Terrace）的救世军宿舍，但他从未给该组织带来太多麻烦，且仅从该处获得微薄的经济资助。

自从失去在卡尔蒂乳品公司的职位后，他在上海短期受雇于以下机构：-

上海公共租界工部局警务处。    档案号.___

报告                        ________分局，
(2)                           日期 ________ 19

事由___

制作人___转呈人___

1. 德和洋行（Messrs. Dodwells），
2. 美国圣经公会（American Bible Society），
3. 太平洋贸易公司（Pacific Trading Co.），
4. Churchyard房地产公司（Churchyard Real Estate），
担任招揽广告业务和/或从事秘书工作的代理人。此外，他在相当长的一段时间内，曾在兰路（Range Road）的大陆英语学院（Continental English College）教授英语。
    除上述细节外，他还因拖欠小额债务而遭到数次非正式投诉。
    从1934年秋到1937年末离开上海前往香港期间，韦斯特伍德居住在租界较贫困地区的各类二等寄宿公寓，包括救世军宿舍。
    尽管已婚并育有两个孩子，但他目前与家人分居。
    韦斯特伍德受过良好教育，谈吐得体，有时甚至才华横溢，但他似乎仅仅因为不合时宜地过度沉溺于烈酒，才使自己陷入了目前的卑微境地。

〔此处有手写签名〕            J. a. Pikes.
